definitions.short: Achiman , the name of an Anakite and of an Israelite
definitions.full: H289. Achiman אֲחִימַן proper name, masculine ( my brother is a gift ? so Thes; compare Arabic ) < אֲחִימָן , see Norzi Num 13:22 GFM Judg 1:10 (after Ven 1 Mich.). 1 a son of Anak Num 13:22 ; Judg 1:10 ; אֲחִימָן֨ Josh 15:14 . 2 a Levite , אֲחִימָ֑ן , 1Chr 9:17 .
definitions.rootNote: or אֲחִימָן ; from 251 and 4480 ; brother of a portion (i.e. gift);
